history.origin: Between 1837 and 1848. This manuscript was commissioned by Antoine d’Abbadie [d’Arrast] in Ethiopia. According to his notes, he commissioned this manuscript to contain the texts that he wanted, as he could not find them in a similar composition anywhere else.
history.acquisition: The manuscript entered Bibliothèque nationale de France in 1902.
